name: Factor
description: Prepared meal-delivery service founded in 2013 and based in Batavia, Illinois, acquired by HelloFresh Group in November 2020, delivering ready-to-eat fresh meals by subscription.

evidence.summary: Factor's official US Ambassador Program page publishes a tiered flat CPA of $50 per customer at 1-19 customers, rising through $60 (20-49) and $65 (50-99) to $70 at 100+, states the rate increases permanently once each band is hit, that commissions carry a 30-day hold and are paid in USD via Lumanu, and that applications are reviewed personally. It also publishes collab@factor75.com for the Ambassador team. Because pay is a flat per-customer bounty rather than a percentage, commission_rate is recorded as null. No explicit no-cap or unlimited-earnings statement appears on the page, so the cap is recorded as unknown.

Referly's listing describes a separate Factor network program paying a fixed $20 per new customer tracked through CJ Affiliate with a 14-day cookie, and notes some third-party sources cite around $25 - a different track from the official Ambassador tiers, flagged here rather than merged.

Beacons Universe reports posts from 564 creators all time, 70 sponsored posts in the last 12 months and 138 public posts in the last 12 months - a mid-size footprint, neither low (~100 scale) nor high (1,000+), so saturation is recorded as unknown.
CB Insights records Factor as founded in 2013, headquartered at Batavia, Illinois, and acquired by HelloFresh Group in November 2020.

affiliate.network: Brand portal (Factor Ambassador Program) / CJ Affiliate

reasons.niche_fit: Ready-meal delivery is a core food-creator niche with strong unboxing and meal-prep content angles.
reasons.ugc_evidence: 564 creators all time and 70 sponsored posts in 12 months on Beacons, plus an official ambassador program.
reasons.compensation: Official tiered flat bounty of $50-$70 per new customer - strong per-conversion pay, recorded as a bounty not a percentage.
reasons.contact_access: Published collab@factor75.com ambassador-team email plus the official program page.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Applications are personally reviewed rather than instant, in the US and EU.
reasons.credibility: Founded 2013 and owned by HelloFresh Group since 2020.

name: Magic Spoon
description: Direct-to-consumer cereal brand launched in 2019, selling high-protein, low-sugar cereals positioned as grown-up versions of childhood cereals; Awin reports it has raised over $100M in funding.

evidence.summary: LinkClicky's Magic Spoon listing states the program runs on Impact and pays 20% commission per sale, with joining via app.impact.com. UpPromote's keto directory corroborates an up-to-20% rate via Impact Radius. No earnings-cap statement was found on any fetched page, so the cap is recorded as unknown.

Magic Spoon's Awin merchant profile publishes a separate network track: 10% commission structure with a 30-day cookie, and states the brand launched direct-to-consumer in 2019 and has raised over $100M. The 20% Impact rate is recorded as the primary rate; the Awin figure is network-specific, not a contradiction to merge.
UpPromote's keto program roundup lists Magic Spoon at a 20% commission rate via Impact Radius and notes a minimum of about 10 cases of cereal per month (~$400 revenue) on that track.

reasons.niche_fit: High-protein cereal is a proven food and fitness-snack creator niche with nostalgic, demo-friendly product.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Live programs on two networks (Impact and Awin) show an established affiliate channel, though no creator counts were published on fetched pages.
reasons.compensation: 20% per sale on Impact is well above the food norm; a separate Awin track pays 10%.
reasons.contact_access: No published program email was found; joining runs through the network listings.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application routes on both Impact and Awin.
reasons.credibility: Launched 2019 with over $100M raised per its Awin profile.

name: Nutrafol

evidence.summary: Lasso's Nutrafol program page states a 10% per-sale commission with a 30-day cookie, with joining via FlexOffers. No earnings-cap statement was found, so the cap is recorded as unknown.

Katalys hosts a separate Nutrafol program quoting a default $40-$200 CPA with VIP rates case-by-case - a different network model from the FlexOffers percentage, so rates are quoted per network and never merged; the 10% FlexOffers rate is the recorded one.

Beacons Universe reports posts from 603 creators all time, 55 sponsored posts in the last 12 months and 285 public posts in the last 12 months - mid-size, neither low nor high in absolute terms, so saturation is recorded as unknown.

Nutrafol's official partner page (aimed at professional/wholesale partners) publishes partners@nutrafol.com as a contact email; the on-site route itself is professional-only, so creator entry is via the network programs above.

reasons.niche_fit: Hair-growth supplements sit squarely in the beauty-meets-health creator niche with strong before/after content.
reasons.ugc_evidence: 603 creators all time and 55 sponsored posts in 12 months on Beacons show steady creator activity.
reasons.compensation: 10% per sale on FlexOffers; a separate Katalys track pays a $40-$200 CPA, so confirm the track at sign-up.
reasons.contact_access: Published partners@nutrafol.com email, though the on-site partner route is professional-focused.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Multiple live network routes (FlexOffers, Katalys, ShareASale per directories).
reasons.credibility: Established New York-based brand per Beacons, with a large professional partner network.

name: WHOOP
description: Boston-based health and fitness wearable company founded in 2012, selling the WHOOP screen-free activity, sleep and recovery tracker with membership plans.

evidence.summary: WhichProgram's WHOOP listing reproduces the Impact network statement: a $50.00 flat commission per order of an eligible 12- or 24-month WHOOP membership (ONE, PEAK and LIFE plans), 30-day cookie, application required, free trials not commissioned. Because pay is a flat bounty, commission_rate is recorded as null. A CommissionDex listing citing $20-$40 per membership conflicts and is flagged here. No earnings-cap statement was found, so the cap is recorded as unknown.

HealthFitnessCoupon reports WHOOP runs its own affiliate application through a Typeform linked from the whoop.com footer, and that admitted affiliates earn a $50 commission on every new member they refer - corroborating the $50 Impact figure via the brand's own route.

Beacons Universe reports posts from 434 creators all time, only 7 sponsored posts in the last 12 months and 307 public posts in 12 months - mid-size creator count, so saturation is recorded as unknown despite the low sponsored-post volume.
WHOOP's official press page states the company was founded in 2012 and is headquartered in Boston.

reasons.niche_fit: Recovery and sleep tracking is a staple of fitness and wellness creator content with high demo value.
reasons.ugc_evidence: 434 creators all time on Beacons and a live Impact program with the brand's own Typeform application route.
reasons.compensation: Flat $50 per eligible 12/24-month membership order - strong per-conversion pay on a high-value membership; a $20-$40 listing conflicts, so confirm in Impact.
reasons.contact_access: No published program email was found; contact runs through the application.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Application required on Impact; the brand also links its own affiliate Typeform from whoop.com.

reasons.ugc_evidence: 526 creators on Beacons and an ambassador program documented past 450 creators on Superfiliate.
